app.name: Three Arts Strategem

home.heroBody: Strategem helps you read the field with Qi Men · Liu Ren · Tai Yi — computable boards, cited readings, decisions that stay yours. Not cookie-cutter fortune-telling.
home.pillarCalcDesc: Calendar and boards are reproducible — same inputs, same result.
home.pillarAiDesc: Every claim is sourced; disclosures when a model is used.
home.pillarDecideDesc: Host–guest framing clarifies stance; it never replaces judgment.

home.curiosityBody: Patterns, palaces, polarity — revealed in layers. The more you read, the more time and position interlock.

learn.title: Learning
learn.lead: Three paths into the Three Arts: frame, board reading, pattern drill. No rush to verdict — first train the eye.
learn.path1.title: Host–guest frame
learn.path1.body: Who asks, who responds; position and time. Learn questions the board can answer.
learn.path2.title: Reading the board
learn.path2.body: Qi Men palaces, Liu Ren keys, Tai Yi station — layer by layer, stem to pattern.
learn.path3.title: Patterns & citations
learn.path3.body: Every pattern carries a source. Practice matching classical text, vernacular, and real context.
learn.disclaimer: Learning is cultural and educational. Not a substitute for medical, legal, or financial expertise.

home.painTitle: Where are you on the path?
home.pain1.title: Stuck loop
home.pain1.body: New jobs, new directions, same outcome. Revisit host–guest framing and timing.
home.pain2.title: At a fork
home.pain2.body: Marriage, founding, moving — fear of a wrong turn. Need a map of conditions, not a verdict.
home.pain3.title: Fine outside, uneasy inside
home.pain3.body: Enough on paper, empty within. Surface blind spots and patterns steering silent choices.
home.diff.us1: Engine boards — same inputs, same result
home.diff.us3: You decide; human review when needed
home.packagesBody: Cast free to see the board. Upgrade for topic reports, timing packs, or guided reading.
home.proofTitle: From people who used the frame
home.proofEmpty: We only publish real, consented notes. Be among the first after your cast.
home.faq1.a: No. It is decision support on three classical systems: computable boards, cited readings; you still decide.
home.faq2.a: Qi Men / Liu Ren / Tai Yi boards, patterns, labeled readings, pin and local history.
home.faq3.a: Premium goes deeper by topic (timing, host–guest, full report) and guided paths — see Packages.
home.faq4.a: We do not sell data. Pins stay local; server accounts follow privacy policy and RLS.
home.faq5.q: What if I am new to the arts?
home.faq5.a: Start with Cast and Learn. Everyday language; terms are glossed.
